customFlutter.title: Custom Flutter Development
customFlutter.description: From concept to deployment, we build custom Flutter applications tailored to your business needs.
details: We work with you from the first idea through design, development, and publishing. Every app is built with clean architecture, scalable state management, and a focus on performance and maintainability.
Whether you need a consumer app, B2B tool, or internal platform, we deliver production-ready code and clear documentation so your team can own and extend the product long term.

maintenance.title: App Maintenance & Support
maintenance.description: Keep your app running smoothly with regular updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.
details: Ongoing support prevents small issues from becoming costly problems and keeps your app aligned with the latest OS and dependency updates. We offer flexible plans—from ad-hoc fixes to dedicated monthly retainer—so you can choose the level that fits your budget and roadmap.
Our team handles dependency upgrades, security patches, and performance tuning, and we can add new features or refactor existing code as your requirements evolve.

consulting.title: Consulting & Strategy
consulting.description: Expert guidance on Flutter architecture, best practices, and development strategy.
details: We help teams and stakeholders make informed decisions about stack, architecture, and roadmap. Whether you're starting a new Flutter project, refactoring an existing app, or evaluating Flutter for your organization, we provide clear, actionable recommendations.
Sessions can cover architecture review, code audits, performance profiling, team onboarding to Flutter, or a phased development roadmap with milestones and estimates.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about our app development, website development, and cross-platform services.
faq.crossPlatformAnswer: Cross-platform app development means building one app that runs on multiple platforms—such as iOS and Android—from a single codebase. At RGsoft we use Flutter so you get native-quality performance and one codebase to maintain, which reduces cost and time compared to building separate apps for each platform.
faq.whyFlutterQuestion: Why choose Flutter for app and website development?
faq.whyFlutterAnswer: Flutter lets us build both mobile apps and web from one codebase, with fast performance and consistent UI. We choose Flutter for app development and website development so you get beautiful, responsive experiences on phones, tablets, and desktops without maintaining multiple codebases.
faq.websitesTooQuestion: Do you build websites as well as apps?
faq.websitesTooAnswer: Yes. We offer full website development—responsive sites, landing pages, and web apps—alongside Flutter app development. Whether you need a marketing site, a web app, or a mobile app, we can deliver. Get in touch to discuss your project.
faq.processQuestion: What does your app development process look like?
faq.processAnswer: We start with your goals and scope, then move through design, development, testing, and deployment. For app development we use clean architecture and modern state management; for website development we focus on performance and SEO. You get clear milestones and regular updates so the project stays on track.
faq.howLongQuestion: How long does a typical app or website project take?
faq.howLongAnswer: Timeline depends on scope: a simple landing page or small app might take a few weeks; a full product with custom app development or website development can take several months. We give you an estimate after discussing your requirements and can often phase delivery so you launch sooner.
faq.maintenanceQuestion: Do you offer app maintenance and support?
faq.maintenanceAnswer: Yes. We offer app maintenance and support including updates, bug fixes, security patches, and new features. This keeps your app or website running smoothly and aligned with the latest platforms. Flexible plans are available from ad-hoc fixes to monthly retainers.
faq.whatIsWebsiteDevQuestion: What do you mean by website development?
faq.whatIsWebsiteDevAnswer: Website development at RGsoft includes designing and building responsive websites, landing pages, and web applications. We focus on fast load times, clear structure, and SEO so your site works well for users and search engines. We can also integrate CMS or analytics as needed.
faq.whoNeedsQuestion: Who is your app and website development for?
faq.whoNeedsAnswer: Our app development and website development services are for businesses and teams that need a professional mobile app, a responsive website, or both. We work with startups, SMEs, and larger organizations—from concept and design through to deployment and ongoing support.
